Half of this [[Technologies|technology tree]] deals with [[Corpse|autopsies]] and the kind of organs you can get. It's unlocked by the tutorial.

The other half, the [[alchemy]] part is unlocked upon talking to the [[Clotho|old woman]] in the [[swamp]].

A very small part deals with [[zombie]]s and is unlocked by talking to [[Gunter]].

As you unlock more items along this tree you'll gain access to better [[autopsy]] techniques and resources, as well as more alchemical apparatuses and products.

As part of the [[Game of Crone]] DLC, at the end of this technology tree, there are shown all unlocked [[Tanner|bags]] that you can make (they are not connected to each other or anything else).

[[File:Anatomy and Alchemy.png|thumb]]
<br>
